diagnostic_candidates.justification: Classic signs: crushing substernal chest pain, shortness of breath, sweating.
Chest pain and shortness of breath overlap with arrhythmia presentation.

evidence.content: Classic signs and symptoms of a heart attack include crushing, substernal chest pain, shortness of breath, and sweating.

raw_vector_evidence.limitations: No information on Sildenafil drug interactions.

raw_graph_evidence.summary: Patient presents with acute Chest Pain, Hyperhidrosis, and Dyspnea. Critical: Sildenafil + Nitrate is contra-indicated.

raw_graph_web_evidence: FDA Drug Safety Warning: Co-administration of PDE5 inhibitors (Sildenafil) with organic nitrates produces severe, life-threatening hypotension.
